notes.note: #0.32-37: last six copies of the 15-row leader block that starts in story_140 (#0.23-37); same English as story_140.
Ali calling his GN Fangs ('ike yo'); stretched vowel kept. 'Fangs' as in earlier slices.

#0.40-54: 15 pain cries, one per leader, in the 0659 chain order (00, Wing Zero, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Momotaros, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, RX, Rider 1); the katakana cries fall on the Ultra slots, which confirms the order. #0.46 and #0.51 share the same Japanese -> identical English.
Ali's attack kiai 'choisaa' rendered as a generic battle cry 'Hi-yaaaaaah!!' rather than romanized. Uncertain; could be kept as 'Choisaaa!!' if the project prefers.
#0.56-70: 15-row leader block. 'Yatsu' refers to Arche Gundam (g=m) -> 'he'; 'nante yatsu da' -> 'What a monster'. #0.65 is the Momotaros slot ('yaro') -> 'What a bastard...!!'.
'Hakuhei' = close-quarters/melee combat -> 'up close and personal'. Said after he beats the party with Fangs and blade.
Arche defeated. 'Keshizumi ni natchimatta ka' rendered as a dazed question 'Did my body get burned to a crisp...?'
#0.74-75 Ali's dying taunt; subject 'you lot' = the heroes; 'their justice is meaningless before Regis'. Cut at the matching point between rows.
Ankh responding to Ali's claim about Regis; trailing full-width space in source dropped.
Ankh's exclamation 'tsukaeru no ka!' read as surprised realisation, not a question.
'Colony Laser' per glossary (source has a middle dot).

#0.22-39 are leader pairs ('What!?' + 'But if we just beat you'), one pair per leader in chain order; #0.38/39 is the W pair (#0.39 in story_142 has a longer variant). Subject of 'taoseba' restored as 'we' (the team fights Reborns); the speaker alone ('I') is also possible. The pairs continue in story_142 (#0.40-51).
W slot: 'nani...!!' with a pause instead of 'nani!!' -> 'What...!!'.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks follow the 0659 Pt_Chara_Check order (confirmed by katakana Ultra cries in #0.40-54). Uncertain: 0668#0.55 Ali kiai rendered generically; 0669#0.23 etc. subject restored as 'we'. No new names.
